verdict.rationale: Milvus docs claim support for vector CRUD operations and for 'vector data persistence and management' across Lite, Standalone and Distributed (milvus-docs-17), which implies entity deletion. Local Lite mode keeps all data in a user-specified file, giving direct control over where data lives (milvus-docs-1, milvus-docs-22). An old community thread said deletion was not yet supported (milvus-comm-2), but it described a planned feature and is superseded by the current CRUD claim, so it does not create a dispute. Missing for 10: documented delete/drop APIs, retention or TTL policies, guarantees of physical purge after deletion (e.g. compaction), and independent hands-on corroboration.
